turns.q: How long does the replacement take?
turns.replyTail:
There isn’t a confirmed exact timeframe for warranty replacements because the claim must first be approved and the item must be available.

Approved replacement orders are sent by standard shipping only. For U.S. and Canadian orders, most shipments leave the warehouse within 1-2 business days, then standard delivery typically takes 3-7 business days. Expedited shipping isn’t available for replacement orders.

turns.q: What if more than one item in my order is affected?
turns.replyTail:
If more than one item is damaged, include every affected item in the same warranty claim. Please add a clear photo or video of each item, your order number, and a description of each issue.

The Standard Warranty applies once per item purchased, claims are subject to approval, and free items aren’t covered. If approved, each eligible item may qualify for the same-item replacement, subject to availability, or store credit.

Submit everything here: Submit a warranty claim
